# SalesDrone — release and runtime investigation
Production-only telemetry. Detector inputs are lookback summaries, not installed alerts. Review thresholds and use the operator guide. Runtime latency is a mean; optional histogram p95 requires tenant bucket ingestion. No tenant resource IDs or notification destinations are included.

Deployment and runtime sections use explicit documented lookbacks; change them together when investigating a release.

input.value:
timeseries total=sum(salesdrone.http.requests), failed=sum(salesdrone.http.requests, filter:{http.status_class=="5xx"}, default:0), by:{service.name,operation}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production"}, from:now()-2h, interval:5m, union:true
| fieldsAdd server_error_percent=if(total[]>0,100.0*failed[]/total[],else:null), server_success_percent=if(total[]>0,100.0*(total[]-failed[])/total[],else:null)

timeseries mean_duration_s=avg(salesdrone.http.duration), by:{service.name,operation}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production"}, from:now()-2h, interval:5m

timeseries total=sum(salesdrone.http.requests, scalar:true), failed=sum(salesdrone.http.requests, filter:{http.status_class=="5xx"}, default:0, scalar:true), by:{service.name,operation}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production"}, from:now()-10m, union:true
| fieldsAdd observations=total, value=if(total>0,100.0*failed/total,else:null)

| fieldsAdd eligible = isNotNull(value) and value>=0 and observations>=20
| fieldsAdd breach = if(eligible,value>5,else:null)

timeseries value=max(salesdrone.outbox.records, scalar:true), by:{service.name}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production" and state=="Rejected"}, from:now()-5m

| fieldsAdd eligible = isNotNull(value) and value>=0
| fieldsAdd breach = if(eligible,value>0,else:null)

timeseries value=sum(salesdrone.telemetry.exports, scalar:true), by:{service.name,signal}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production" and outcome=="failure"}, from:now()-5m

| fieldsAdd eligible = isNotNull(value) and value>=0
| fieldsAdd breach = if(eligible,value>0,else:null)

timeseries value=max(salesdrone.queue.oldest_due_age, scalar:true), by:{service.name,queue}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production" and queue=="reminders"}, from:now()-5m

| fieldsAdd eligible = isNotNull(value) and value>=0
| fieldsAdd breach = if(eligible,value>300,else:null)

timeseries total=sum(salesdrone.gen_ai.requests, scalar:true), failed=sum(salesdrone.gen_ai.requests, filter:{outcome=="failure"}, default:0, scalar:true), by:{service.name,model,operation}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production"}, from:now()-10m, union:true
| fieldsAdd observations=total, value=if(total>0,100.0*failed/total,else:null)

| fieldsAdd eligible = isNotNull(value) and value>=0 and observations>=10
| fieldsAdd breach = if(eligible,value>20,else:null)

timeseries backlog=max(salesdrone.queue.backlog), oldest_due_age_s=max(salesdrone.queue.oldest_due_age), by:{service.name,queue}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production"}, from:now()-2h, interval:5m, union:true

timeseries records=max(salesdrone.outbox.records), by:{service.name,state}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production"}, from:now()-2h, interval:5m

timeseries mean_duration_s=avg(salesdrone.db.duration), by:{service.name,operation,collection}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production"}, from:now()-2h, interval:5m

timeseries mean_duration_s=avg(salesdrone.gen_ai.duration), by:{service.name,model,operation,outcome}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production"}, from:now()-2h, interval:5m

fetch events, from:now()-24h
| filter event.kind == "SDLC_EVENT" and event.type == "deployment" and event.status == "finished"
| filter service.namespace == "avinyatech" and deployment.environment.name == "production"
| fields timestamp, event.id, service.version, build.commit, github.run.id, pipeline.run.url, cicd.deployment.status, dt.system.bucket
| sort timestamp desc

fetch logs, from:now()-1h
| filter service.namespace == "avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name, "salesdrone-")
| filter deployment.environment.name == "production"
| filter isNotNull(error.type)
| summarize failures=count(), by:{operation,error.type,loglevel}
| sort failures desc

fetch user.events, from:now()-1h
| filter in(url.domain,array("sales-drone-avinya.web.app","sales-drone-avinya.firebaseapp.com"))
| filter startsWith(url.path,"/api/v1/") and isNotNull(trace.id)
| fields start_time, trace.id, span.id, request.trace_context_hint
| sort start_time desc
| limit 20

timeseries estimated_request_p95_s=percentile(salesdrone.http.duration_bucket,95), by:{service.name,operation}, filter:{service.namespace=="avinyatech" and startsWith(service.name,"salesdrone-") and deployment.environment.name=="production"}, from:now()-2h, interval:5m
